answers.how: Callisto moves through approximately 0.487 radians in 3.3 s. Orbital diameter = 2 × 0.627 × 3.3 / 0.487.
Callisto travels approximately 27.1 pixels/s, giving 0.0231 m/pixel. Its diameter is approximately 5 pixels.
Jupiter's diameter is approximately 74.5 pixels. Using the motion-derived scale of 0.0231 m/pixel gives 1.72 m.
